title: Особи, місця та установи
fields_and_relations: Пошук за назвою/варіантами/ідентифікаторами; три типи сутностей.
required_interaction: Порожній результат/можливий дублікат; створення пропозиції замість автоматичного merge.

implementation.view_model: Type tabs, search, create distinct person/place/institution records Collector directory for R01: independent person records with stable registry codes, edit and research/session links; no account required. Settlement directory: full administrative labels, historical-name/code search, sourced current and chronological descriptions, coordinates, foreign/disappeared places and multiple regional concepts. Existing sessions retain recorded wording.
limitations: Browser-local storage only; synthetic examples; no register import or automatic reconciliation with D11/D20. Regional assignments and external identifiers are append-only in this first interface.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store; fixture version 9
permissions: field.write or catalog.write in archive scope; vocabulary.write for terms
Settlement mutations require catalog.write in the archive; expected revision prevents stale edits.
implementation.atomicity: Authorize, expected revision, clone, validate, hash, commit. No partial mutation on failure.
